purpose: Give PCTM the calibration budget DPT-SR received (review r2, Major).
pctm_as_special_case: kappa=0, pair_penalty=0, exposure_power=0, power=0, completion strength=0
split: training-internal LOO; 8192-user sample (seed 20260909); 80/20 SHA-256 user partition
axes: popularity offset in (-0.2,0.2); history_i weight in (0,1) with remainder on kernel 0; path axis void at eta=0; anchor kept if best
optimizer: event sweep over open stable-ranking intervals (dpt_sr/rank_calibration.py)
test: selected coordinate frozen, evaluated once; paired bootstrap and sign-flip on user NDCG@10
relocation: Script moved from a session scratch folder into the repository on 2026-09-24; only file paths and command-line options changed. Re-running it on beauty and ml1m reproduces inner_fit.json, test.json and per_user.npz exactly.
